text:
maria: Quick ask — can someone run a smoke comparison A100 / H100 / L40S for the new 32k model? Need p50/p99, throughput at batch=1 and batch=8, and an approximate token cost delta. Prefer a short run (1000 tokens) but include warm vs cold KV cache if possible. cc @sam @akshay
sam: I can kick this off tonight. Which image + driver should I use for parity?
akshay: Use runtime:v2.3.1 and driver 525.85.01 for H100 parity. L40S nodes are on 525.60 so note that in the post. Also enable `--kv-cache` toggles.
sam: command I'll run:
```
bench-run --model redwood-32k --skus a100 h100 l40s --batches 1 8 --seq-len 2048 --tokens 1000 --metrics p50,p99,throughput,cost --kv-cache warm cold --output csv
```
maria: perfect. please add a quick note if you see microbursts or p99 spikes on any sku (esp h100) so we can flag eng-sre. thanks.
infra-bot: Job queued: bench-job-420135 on pool 'night-sweep' (owner: sam). ETA ~6h.
sam: started run, will post the raw CSV to #eng-runtime-bench-results when done. quick note: I observed a ~8% p99 variance on one h100 node during a short dry-run with batch=8.
maria: hmm, can you paste the stderr snippet? microbursts tend to look like kernel stalls or nvlink glitches.
sam: stderr snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T22:12:05Z] WARN kv_cache: cache-miss-rate=0.12
[2026-03-16T22:12:05Z] INFO latency: sample=12.3ms p50=11.9ms p99=76.4ms
[2026-03-16T22:12:06Z] WARN driver: transient timeout on nvlink transfer
```
akshay: that nvlink transient timeout rings a bell — eng-sre rolled a driver tweak last week. ping @nate to confirm whether it's expected.
nate: yep, we pushed a microdriver patch; some h100 fleets see short nvlink timeouts during high-concurrency thin-batch cases. We're scheduling a wider roll tomorrow but it can perturb p99. If you want clean parity runs, use `--isolate-node` and `--nvlink=off` on a small pool to compare baseline.
maria: good call. Sam — can you re-run h100 with `--isolate-node` and `--nvlink=off` for batch=8 after the main sweep? just to have a controlled data point.
sam: will do — re-run queued after the main job completes. ETA +3h.
maria: target is to have CSV + a 1-paragraph summary by EOD tomorrow. Please add the raw commands and node ids in the post. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Job update: bench-job-420135 completed on h100 nodes (some retries). Results uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/nightly/2109876543/results.csv
sam: uploaded CSV and summary to #eng-runtime-bench-results. Summary: A100 vs H100: p50 similar, H100 p99 shows +6–9% tail in shared pool runs, but isolated runs remove the delta. L40S higher median latency but cost per-token lower for short sequences. Raw CSV + node IDs in thread.
maria: awesome — thanks everyone. we'll track the driver roll and mark any follow-ups in the perf board.
akshay: adding a small action: create a short regression alert if H100 p99 increases >5% vs baseline on nightly sweeps.
maria: assigned. closing this quick-coord thread. :white_check_mark:
